normalization.edition_selector: exact numbered lg xml:id, then 1-based child l
normalization.query: NFC Devanagari to IAST using inherent a, virama, vowel signs and avagraha; remove ASCII hyphens on both sides, keep spaces, case and phonemes. A word with an unhandled mark is flagged.
normalization.line: NFC of XML string value of each l; offsets in the resulting Unicode code points; source hyphen remains in offset coordinates. Never cross a line.
normalization.W: both edges coincide with whitespace, line end/start, or printed punctuation . , ; : ! ? / | ( ) [ ] “ ” ".
normalization.S: one or both otherwise unbounded edges are printed hyphens; remaining edges must be bounded
normalization.I: at least one edge is internal to continuous text
normalization.hit: line:start:end:class. The end offset is exclusive. Multiple occurrences are retained with |. Status takes strongest W then S then I. An apostrophe or avagraha is part of the string.
normalization.interpretation: word boundaries are graphic. I and S can be parts of a longer expression. No external sandhi is undone, no title association is inferred from an occurrence.
normalization.empty_interval_field: A single period represents an empty interval list.

edition.projection: NFC string value of l; offsets in Unicode code points, 0-based and end-exclusive; verse label excluded for Māgha
